verdict.line: You lose this lane if you trade autos into a raised Counter Strike or stand still through his level 6 all-in; you win it by poking from max range and denying his Leap Strike windows.

brief.thesis: Teemo outranges Jax at 680 versus his 700 Leap Strike gap-closer and 300 Empower/Counter Strike range, so the entire lane is about whether you poke from outside his dash-and-stun combo or walk into it. Jax's real threat isn't the lane state (52.6% Teemo win rate over 78 games, roughly even) but the solo kill — his Counter Strike (E) punishes auto-attack habits and his Relentless Assault (R) ramps hard in extended trades, so short pokes win and long trades don't.

theirWindow.what: Stop attacking immediately and back out of his 300-range stance — Counter Strike dodges all incoming basic attacks, and if you keep swinging you'll eat the stun plus its damage for free. OP.GG's own read on this matchup is exactly this: don't stand in E range.

yourWindow.when: Right as his Counter Strike stun lands or he commits Leap Strike (Q)
yourWindow.what: Land Blinding Dart (Q) on him the instant the stun resolves — on an 8s cooldown you can afford to spend it here — so his follow-up auto or Empowered (W) swing whiffs. His Leap Strike is also down for 17/14/11/8/5s by rank, so once he's used it you can walk up and stack Toxic Shot (E) freely.

start.why: Taken in 76.7% of games at a 55.7% win rate over 79 games — the mana and AP let you spam Toxic Shot autos and Blinding Dart without running dry while you poke from range.

boots.why: 53.6% win rate over 28 games — the flat magic penetration matters more here than mobility since Jax's gap closer, not your positioning, decides engage distance.

core.why: First item in the highest-sample core path (52.2% over 23 games); the proc lets your poke autos clear wave and chip Jax at once without extending the trade.
DoT scaling punishes Jax for walking up to trade and keeps ticking even after he disengages with Leap Strike.
Completes the 52.2%-win-rate path; the burst amp turns your poke into real damage once he commits to an all-in.

situational.when: he builds no magic resist and you're ahead on poke damage already
you're fighting to keep E (Toxic Shot) autos landing in extended skirmishes
you need the extra utility/survivability piece in a longer game

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest pick rate (28.3%) at 53.3% win rate — it rewards the poke-and-reset pattern this lane demands instead of a sustained trade Jax's R would win.

summoners.why: Run in 85.7% of games at a 55.6% win rate — Ignite is how you convert your range advantage into the solo kills Jax is otherwise favored for, and Flash resets any Leap Strike engage he lands.

playing.title: Poke, don't melee
playing.detail: Stay at your 680 auto/Q range and let Toxic Shot (E) do its damage over time. Only close distance when his Leap Strike (Q) is on cooldown.

playing.title: Never auto into raised E
playing.detail: If he visibly enters Counter Strike, stop attacking and walk out of the 300-range stance — attacking into it just feeds him a free stun.

playing.title: Blind the follow-up, not the engage
playing.detail: Save Blinding Dart (Q) for the moment right after his Counter Strike stun or Empowered (W) hit lands so the next swing whiffs, rather than wasting it pre-emptively.

playing.title: Track his Leap Strike cooldown
playing.detail: At rank 1 it's 17s; by rank 5 it's 5s. Respect his engage range far more once he's maxed Q.

playing.title: Disengage before level 6 all-ins ramp
playing.detail: Relentless Assault (R) gives him bonus attack speed and a bonus-damage third hit the longer a fight runs, so cut trades short rather than standing in extended exchanges.

playing.title: Seed mushrooms for vision, not burst
playing.detail: Use Noxious Trap (R) on tri-bush and jungle entrances to deny ganks and warn you when he's about to jump the wall, since the 1s cooldown lets you lay several cheaply.

playing.title: Push poke with Shiv online
playing.detail: Once Statikk Shiv is built, your wave-clear autos also chip Jax, so you can apply pressure without ever walking into his 300-range kit.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Do not stand in range of Counter Strike (E)! Use Blinding Dart [Q] to prevent him from dealing additional damage afterwards!
